_comment: PREIshare semantic search sample listings (Sprint 5). Fields match supabase/migrations/20250315000000_enable_pgvector_properties.sql: id (uuid), title, description, city, property_type, price. embedding is generated by scripts/seed-property-embeddings.ts. Fixed ids make re-running the seed an upsert, not duplicates.

properties.title: Lakeside A-frame on a private cove
properties.description: Secluded A-frame tucked into the pines at the edge of a calm lake, with its own dock and kayak launch. The setting is peaceful with no road noise, just loons in the evening. It has a strong short-term rental history, booking most summer weekends and holidays.

properties.title: Rustic woodland retreat on the river
properties.description: Cozy log retreat on two wooded acres with a deck overlooking a slow, clear river. Guests come for fishing, quiet mornings, and stargazing far from city lights. It has been a popular vacation rental with excellent guest reviews.

properties.title: Urban loft above the dining district
properties.description: Open-plan loft with exposed brick on a lively downtown block lined with restaurants, cafes, and cocktail bars. You can walk to offices, the light rail, and weekend nightlife in minutes. It appeals to young professionals who want city energy.

properties.title: Four-bedroom home near a top-rated elementary
properties.description: Spacious two-story house on a quiet cul-de-sac with a fenced backyard and a playground at the end of the street. Kids can walk to a top-rated elementary school, and the middle school is a short drive. Long-term tenant demand from families is steady.

properties.title: Turnkey duplex with tenants in place
properties.description: Recently renovated side-by-side duplex with a new roof, new water heaters, and durable flooring. Both units are leased to reliable long-term tenants, so rent starts on day one. It is a simple, low-maintenance first investment.

properties.title: High-rise condo with skyline views
properties.description: Modern condo on the twentieth floor with floor-to-ceiling windows, a rooftop pool, and a concierge. Located in the center of downtown, a short walk to the arena, theaters, and late-night clubs. Busy and loud on game nights.

properties.title: Suburban starter home with a big yard
properties.description: Three-bedroom rambler with an updated kitchen and a large grassy yard near a community park. Grocery stores and a library are close by. It works well for a young family or a long-term rental.

properties.title: Retail storefront near Lake Street
properties.description: Street-level commercial space currently leased to a cabinet showroom on a busy intersection with heavy traffic. It comes with signage rights and rear loading access. This is a business property, not a residence or vacation home.

properties.title: Ski-town condo steps from the gondola
properties.description: Two-bedroom mountain condo with a fireplace and a heated ski locker, a short walk from the gondola and the main street shops. It earns strong winter rental income from ski visitors and summer income from mountain bikers.

properties.title: Industrial warehouse with loading docks
properties.description: Large concrete-floor warehouse with high ceilings, three loading docks, and three-phase power, close to the freeway interchange. It suits distribution or light manufacturing tenants on multi-year leases.
